reason: The core logic holds. The night list depends on probe 50 alone. Probe 50 (56629533, submitted 05:02:30Z, still PENDING at the 10:33Z poll) reads at 12:02-12:50Z. Probe 51, a CI file, can read after the 23:30Z freeze (about 12:45Z + 10.9 h). All files are built and verified byte-identical, and the night R0/R- files already passed their dummies. Each arm is read against a parent that is already scored, the arms add no stage, and the plan uses 5 slots, which the user approved at 10:19Z. It is not a closed line: DISAPPEARANCE and TAU were not refuted in knobarms_28sep. Five defects need fixing before it is logged. (1) The night composition departs from what the user approved: exp75 + the best public stack + ONE knob arm, and W4 LIFT SPLIT allows 'one ? test'. R25S-2 runs TWO knob arms in both branches. That is justified, because the stack is probe 51 and is already scored, but the user must be told about the swap explicitly, not only that the night is fixed by probe 50. (2) The 00:05/00:25 spacing breaks R18-A7 ('K2-like files >= 40 min apart'; latencies swap by about 20 min; 43/44 co-completed). With 10-minute polls, exp86c and exp89e can complete in the same poll, so an UP cannot be attributed to either. Reading each file's own display is unaffected. 00:45 would still read by about 08:33Z. (3) An M1 CI file submitted at 09:30Z reads at about 18:57Z at exp79a's single measured latency. At the logged upper CI band of 10.9 h it reads at 20:24Z, after the 20:00Z tick deadline, and last-day queue congestion has never been measured. (4) VALUE is public-only. Private EV is about 0 (the finding says so itself). Our record of 2 '+' in about 11 one-lever reads is not clearly above the rate at which 3-decimal rounding alone flips a display up, so a '+' arm is weak evidence, and stacking two of them adds winner's curse. exp88b (TAU 0.7) has a lower P(+) than 0.2: knobarms rank.notes says adding marginal safe forks (DC 0.20/0.225) read as a tie, and cap 8 (more divisions) read '-'. (5) In the most likely branch today, R0/R- with Q2 (morning CI files) unanswered, the night arms sit on exp70g and can at best tie our 0.957 best. The non-CI M2 file exp89d needs both arms to read '+' (P about 0.04), so the EV of the morning chain is about 0 unless the user says yes to Q2. The schedule is sound and the slots cost nothing, but the stated +0.0002 is an upper-end public-only figure.
fix: Log R25S-2 as the pre-score line before probe 50 is terminal, with these amendments. (a) Add an explicit line: R18-A7 40-min spacing is waived for the two arms. Arms read only their own display vs parent from the submissions list; the 'equal + attributable UP' clause is dropped. Or keep 00:05/00:45, which still reads by about 08:33Z. (b) M1 CI hard cutoff 08:45Z instead of 09:30Z (10.9 h tail -> 19:39Z). If the arm reads are not in by then, M1 falls back to a non-CI file from the M2 list. Submit M1 the moment the second arm read (or the first '+' plus the other terminal) lands. (c) Under R- only, optionally swap exp88b (TAU 0.7, more safe forks in the same direction as exp85a's +3) for exp88c (DIS 1.75). This gives a two-sided sign read on the DISAPPEARANCE knob, so M1 becomes single-arm; no new dummy is needed, since exp88c was pushed at 10:07Z and must be PASSED by 23:30Z. (d) The user line must say three things. First, night = exp75 + two knob arms, because the 'best public stack' is probe 51 and is already scored. Second, without a yes to Q2 the morning chain can at best tie 0.957. Third, M1/M2 are public-only single-embryo reads, and exp75/#37 remain the private hedge on the finals card. (e) Add a ledger rule so the exp89 CI members go to safetail_ci, as R25S-3 notes; they currently fall to safetail. Make it before any exp89 dummy is logged.
